description: This Java source file defines a database migration class Migration_18_19 for the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It handles migrating database version 18 to 19 and includes logic to clear the disk cache of Glide to fix avatar display issues in multi-user setups.

classes.name: Migration_18_19
classes.description: A class extending Room's Migration to handle database migration from version 18 to 19, primarily clearing the Glide disk cache.

methods.name: Migration_18_19
methods.description: Constructor initializing migration from version 18 to 19 with application context.

methods.name: migrate
methods.description: Overrides the migrate method to execute cache clearing of Glide on a background thread.
